subject: Request: Custom SLA addendum + evidence package for enterprise order form
messages:
From: Danielle Owen <danielle.owen@medicore.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medicore.com, contracts@medicore.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: custom SLA addendum + evidence for enterprise order form

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To advance procurement and legal review, Medicore needs a proposed SLA addendum (order form exhibit) that captures the following high-level commitments for our enterprise MSA/SOW:

- Availability: 99.97% monthly uptime (global)
- Latency: P95 <= 150ms for 512-token generation; P99 <= 350ms
- Incident notification: initial alert within 15 minutes for Sev1 incidents
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II excerpt, regional audit logs (13 months), latency traces from the pilot, and confirmation of KMS/HSM key management support

Can you produce a proposed addendum with order-form language and an evidence package we can attach to our procurement file? We are also collecting any suggested fallback/failover language for cross-region routing and reserved capacity during cutover.

I attached a short procurement statement with our internal timeline. Target: finalize order form and have signatures by 2027-08-20 if feasible.

Best,
Danielle
Danielle Owen
Sr. Procurement Manager, Medicore Health Systems
[Attachment: Medicore_SLA_ask_v1.pdf]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Owen <danielle.owen@medicore.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum + evidence for enterprise order form

Hi Danielle —

Appreciate the clarity and timeline. I’m looping in Ben (Sales lead) and Laura (Legal ops) to coordinate a draft and evidence pack.

Quick ask from our side to help scope the addendum: can you confirm (if available) the expected average RPS and typical request token sizes for the pilot/early production? That will help Marcus and our infra team size the reserved pool and model variant recommendations.

We will:
- Draft an Availability & Latency Exhibit for the order form
- Compile the SOC2 excerpt and audit/log retention plan we can share under NDA
- Propose operational commitments (response SLAs for incident and root-cause analysis timeline)

I’ll aim to get a first draft and evidence checklist back by EOD Thu 2027-08-05.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[PRIYA signature]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Owen <danielle.owen@medicore.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum + evidence for enterprise order form

Danielle —

Thanks for the ask — happy to own the order-form language side. A few clarifying points that will determine the specific wording and whether an Availability Exhibit or an Order-Form Annex makes more sense:

1) Traffic profile: please confirm expected peak QPS and average daily requests (pilot vs. production).
2) Model fidelity: are you expecting the open model we demoed (Redwood-curated variant) or a customer-licensed variant pinned to a specific version? The latter affects rollback/fallback language.
3) Credits: would Medicore consider a small onboarding credit in lieu of a higher P99 uptime guarantee during the first 60 days of production?

I’m attaching a working draft of the addendum with two options (tight latency SLO + premium support vs. standard SLO + credits). Please review and indicate preference.

Next steps: Laura, can you review the redlines for any legal concerns re: evidence delivery windows and log export obligations?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_sla_addendum_draft.docx]

From: Danielle Owen <danielle.owen@medicore.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medicore.com, contracts@medicore.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum + evidence for enterprise order form

Ben / Priya —

Thanks. Answers below and attached artifacts from our pilot:

- Traffic: pilot averaged 4 QPS (bursty), expected production initially 30 QPS with spikes to 120 QPS during batch windows. Typical prompt size ~250 input tokens / 512 generation tokens.
- Model: we want a pinned model version for reproducibility; please include rollback/fallback behavior in the addendum.
- Credits: Medicore is open to a 30-day graduated credit if Redwood requires a tuning window, but the baseline SLOs should be in the contract.

Evidence attached: pilot latency traces (sampled), plus a short procurement statement. We can execute an NDA for any SOC2 or internal evidence you prefer to share.

Attachments: pilot_latency_traces.csv, procurement_statement.pdf

Regards,
Danielle
[Attachment: pilot_latency_traces.csv; procurement_statement.pdf]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: None
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Technical feasibility notes — proposed evidence & order-form language

Ben/Priya —

Reviewed the pilot traces Danielle provided. High-level recommendations for the addendum and the evidence pack:

- Feasibility: P95 <= 150ms and P99 <= 350ms are achievable with a dedicated pool (reserved capacity) + region pinning for the primary traffic. For spikes to 120 QPS, enable autoscale + burst capacity and specify warm-up/compute reservation in the order form.
- Evidence: we can provide (under NDA) a SOC2 excerpt, a 30-day slice of latency traces, and exportable audit logs (13 months retention) tied to the tenant id. For HSM/KMS: confirm support for customer-managed keys in Redwood Private; we will need an L3 contact to validate the key policy.
- Suggested order-form clause (draft text to include):
  • Availability Exhibit: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to maintain monthly availability of 99.97% for the Services specified in this Order Form. Availability will be measured on a tenant basis excluding scheduled maintenance windows provided with at least 72 hours' notice."
  • Latency SLO: "For configured model variant <MODEL-V1>, Redwood agrees to a P95 latency at or below 150ms and a P99 latency at or below 350ms measured on production traffic using the tenant's primary region. Remedies: service credit tiers tied to monthly uptime and sustained P99 breaches exceeding two consecutive days."

Attached a short note listing the telemetry artifacts we can reasonably provide and suggested SR/incident SLAs. Happy to refine wording for legal.

-Marcus
Senior Applied Inference Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: technical_evidence_requirements.txt]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Owen <danielle.owen@medicore.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood mutual action plan and next steps — Medicore order form

Danielle —

Thanks for the fast responses and the pilot artifacts. Attached is a mutual action plan and a consolidated redline of the Availability & Latency Exhibit (two options: A = tight SLO + premium onboarding; B = baseline SLO + 30-day credit). Key asks for Medicore to confirm:

1) Preferred option (A or B)
2) Confirmation of pinned model version id and whether KMS keys will be customer-managed
3) A primary technical contact for HSM/KMS validation (we need an L3)

If you confirm option A, we will:
- Prepare an order-form annex with the Availability Exhibit and the fallback region routing language
- Provide the SOC2 excerpt and a 30-day telemetry slice under NDA within 3 business days of NDA execution
- Provide a DocuSign link for the order form (attached link below)

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ABC123MEDICORE-orderform
HubSpot: hsr_1002345

I’ve attached the mutual action plan and marked internal owners. Laura will follow up with the legal redlines on evidence delivery windows. Ben will coordinate commercial terms and any onboarding credit mechanics. Marcus will own the telemetry export and technical acceptance criteria.

Requested: please reply EOW 2027-08-13 with confirmation so we can target signature before 2027-08-20.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
